A quiet blend of emotion and color, this piece captures a fleeting moment between chaos and calm. Soft textures and bold strokes come together to express inner movement and silent strength. Inspired by nature and human connection, this artwork reflects harmony in contrast.

Soft horizons awaken in silence,
where memory and hope gently meet—
and something new begins to breathe.

In every shade she releases,
the soul loosens its chains—
becoming nothing but light and movement.

Written in silence,
carried in quiet eyes—
a life speaking without words.

In the freedom of movement,
the heart forgets its weight—
and remembers how to fly.

Between hiding and revealing,
truth appears for a moment—
soft, fragile, and real.

A figure of wings,
A quiet presence—
felt where tenderness and compassion remains.

In perfect stillness,
strength needs no movement—
it simply is.

In the quiet she creates,
nothing needs permission—
she simply becomes herself.

From shattered pieces,
a truer self rises—
free, fearless, and whole.

In stillness, she listens to what the heart whispers.
Sometimes, looking far away is the only way to find yourself.

In the space between shadow and glow,
a quiet truth waits—
soft, steady, and unseen.

Between shadow and light,
a truer self begins to appear—
not created, only revealed.

In stillness, awakening begins.
Nothing to seek, nothing to hold—
only the quiet truth of being.

The past does not call to hold us—
only to remind us
how far the heart has traveled.

A quiet blend of emotion and color, this piece captures a fleeting moment between chaos and calm. Soft textures and bold strokes come together to express inner movement and silent strength. Inspired by nature and human connection, this artwork reflects harmony in contrast.

Within silence, her strength becomes gentle light.
Peace is not distant—it is already resting inside.

From a single breath of silence,
calm begins to take form—
simple, endless, whole.

In the quiet, the self returns to its true shape.
Nothing is missing—only waiting to be felt.

Between silence and motion,
something gentle tries to speak—
a truth only the heart can hear.

Amid fragments and noise,
the soul finds a quiet center—
whole, even in pieces.

Forms drift between matter and dream.
What seems distant is quietly connected—
the universe turning within itself.

site_content.title: Hero Statement / Quote
site_content.content_en: “Stillness is never empty—it is full of unseen movement.” — Shalona
site_content.content_fr: « Le calme n’est jamais vide — il est plein d’un mouvement invisible. » — Shalona
site_content.content_de: «Stille ist niemals leer – sie ist voller unsichtbarer Bewegung.» – Shalona

site_content.title: Where the Visible Meets the Unseen
site_content.content_en: I am an intuitive mixed-media artist creating from the quiet space where memory, emotion, and energy collide. Living in Richterswil, Switzerland, I find endless inspiration in the stillness of nature and the unseen currents of life.

site_content.title: About Shalona (Biography Opening)
site_content.content_en: I am Shalona, a mixed media artist based in Richterswil, Switzerland. My art combines original photography, unconventional materials, and expressive layers of color. Through this creative process, I explore the space between what we see and what we feel. I create from the quiet space between what is visible and what is felt. My creative journey begins where words fall silent. Here, memories, emotions, and unseen energy find expression through color, texture, and imagery.

site_content.title: Artistic Vision and Inspiration
site_content.content_en: My artistic vision centers on resilience, transformation, fragility, and hidden strength. Through symbolic figures and dreamlike atmospheres, I explore the emotions that shape our inner worlds. In particular, I find inspiration in the subtle relationship between color, memory, and energy. Colors play an essential role in my work. For example, gentle tones can suggest stillness, while expressive contrasts can communicate emotional movement.

site_content.title: My Creative Process
site_content.content_en: My creative process combines intuition, experimentation, and thoughtful observation. I begin by exploring my own photography, mixed media, and unconventional materials. Then, I introduce expressive layers of color and texture to develop the composition. Throughout this process, I remain open to unexpected discoveries. Instead of controlling every detail, I allow the artwork to guide my next decision.

site_content.title: Art as a Space for Reflection
site_content.content_en: I do not seek to give answers. Instead, I create opportunities for reflection. Through my art, I invite viewers to connect with their imagination, memories, and personal truths. Moreover, I believe that each person experiences art differently. One viewer may discover a familiar emotion, while another may recognize a hidden memory or an unexpected perspective. For this reason, I see artistic expression as an ongoing conversation between the creator and the viewer.
